entries.subject: the Buddha
entries.object: staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove

spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi: There the Buddha addressed the mendicants, “bhikkhavo”ti.

entries.task_id: suppose there|was|a woman or man who was young
entries.description: Suppose there was a woman or man who was young
entries.subject: Suppose there
entries.object: a woman or man who was young

spans.text: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, itthī vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko ahikuṇapena vā kukkurakuṇapena vā manussakuṇapena vā kaṇṭhe āsattena aṭṭiyeyya harāyeyya jiguccheyya; Suppose there was a woman or man who was young, youthful, and fond of adornments.

entries.subject: Suppose there

spans.text: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, cakkhumā puriso āpāthagatānaṁ rūpānaṁ adassanakāmo assa; Suppose there was a person with clear eyes, and some undesirable sights came into their range of vision.
